_comment: Phase-1 + heading hold (genome/HANDOFF_heading_hold.md): c172x/T38/737 heading_hold on with genome's exported keys; f16 heading_hold off (FD jsbsim_root, throttle_max 0.5). Same task/GA budget as configs/phase1.json, which is unchanged (heading hold is opt-in).

phase1_c172x._why: = genome/exports/evolution_phase1_profiles.json phase1_c172x (generated from genome/aircraft_profiles/phase1_shared.json) + the items that needed code here: 600 fpm ramp with 0.1 g corners, climb-rate FF, comfort 0.05, log0 on ki_alt/ki_pitch, profile-scaled roll gains (genome adapter sim_fixed), FD jsbsim_root | heading hold from genome/HANDOFF_heading_hold.md (export 04:50 PT): heading_hold, bank_limit_deg, hdg_i_limit_deg, w_heading, hdg_rms_ref_deg, kp_hdg (log) / ki_hdg (log0) bounds verbatim.

phase1_T38._why: = genome/exports/evolution_phase1_profiles.json phase1_T38 (generated from genome/aircraft_profiles/phase1_shared.json) + the items that needed code here: 600 fpm ramp with 0.1 g corners, climb-rate FF, comfort 0.05, log0 on ki_alt/ki_pitch, profile-scaled roll gains (genome adapter sim_fixed), FD jsbsim_root; thr_kp/thr_ki at full precision (genome adapter sim_fixed): the export rounds them to 6 digits, which moves costs by 1e-8..5e-7 relative; with full precision genome's best genomes re-fly bit-identically | heading hold from genome/HANDOFF_heading_hold.md (export 04:50 PT): heading_hold, bank_limit_deg, hdg_i_limit_deg, w_heading, hdg_rms_ref_deg, kp_hdg (log) / ki_hdg (log0) bounds verbatim.

phase1_737._why: = genome/exports/evolution_phase1_profiles.json phase1_737 (generated from genome/aircraft_profiles/phase1_shared.json) + the items that needed code here: 600 fpm ramp with 0.1 g corners, climb-rate FF, comfort 0.05, log0 on ki_alt/ki_pitch, profile-scaled roll gains (genome adapter sim_fixed), FD jsbsim_root; thr_kp/thr_ki at full precision (genome adapter sim_fixed): the export rounds them to 6 digits, which moves costs by 1e-8..5e-7 relative; with full precision genome's best genomes re-fly bit-identically | heading hold from genome/HANDOFF_heading_hold.md (export 04:50 PT): heading_hold, bank_limit_deg, hdg_i_limit_deg, w_heading, hdg_rms_ref_deg, kp_hdg (log) / ki_hdg (log0) bounds verbatim.

phase1_f16._why: NOT in the shared set (genome/ALIGNMENT.md covers c172x/T38/737 only). Loads Flight Dynamics' prepared f16 from jsbsim_root (INTERFACE.md s5: zero-weight payload_placeholder at point-mass index 0, Pilot moved to 1, zero flex force/mass; no network sockets, so no stripped copy is needed). Trim 350 KCAS / 10000 ft, gear up, mode 1: alpha 1.045 deg, throttle 0.2836 (dry, pos 0.567), identical to FD's s5b. throttle_max 0.5 = MIL, no afterburner (same convention as the T38). Phase-1 task/fitness rules as the others. Envelope as bench_jets-j1 (min 200 KCAS, n +9/-3). Clamp, helper-loop gains (speed PI, roll) and gene ranges from genome's adapter for f16 (control-power scaled; same KCAS => ~same qbar), ranges = union with the prototype ranges, as ALIGNMENT #11 does for the other jets. Note (FD s5d): the f16 stick is an FBW pitch-rate/g demand, not a surface deflection. | heading_hold false: f16 aileron-cmd-norm is a FBW roll-rate demand (FD INTERFACE §5d); needs its own derivation (genome handoff).
